reviews.review:
Hello, today we are reviewing warframe. The saying is quite accurate "space-ninja simulator" or "Free To Play Destiny". However, this ninja, or this protagonist doesn't just stealth. The gameplay is repetitive, but somehow it keeps dragging you back, time to time. I've played/followed the game since the stamina system (I think that's pre-release or shortly after release), and played after, then stopped, and came back years later in like, 2018 to start again, and resume my playthrough. It's a really unique game. There are a lot of mission types you can play, and the best thing is, you can play with friends while slaughtering/dying. However that might not be true for all missions. This game is fantastic, because the devs keep pushing updates, communicating with us, and it's a game where they have EU servers, even though the devs themselves are from the US. Unfortunately, frequent updates mean frequent bugs, and since it's a big game, these are common. But they keep pushing hotfixes out, in a few hours after the bug gets reported, proving that they care. What if you are in game while this patch happens? You get notified, but you can finish your mission. Then when you complete/leave your mission, you are asked to quit and update the game, so you can't continue playing. 

There are a lot of good people, friendly people, but there are also some toxic/unfriendly people who are just mean for some reason. I recommend you don't get mean, because it's only a game. Earlier I mentioned that the game keeps dragging you back. The only reason behind this is: new content. So the devs who do the game know their sh*t, since they get a lot of players. Also the game's tutorial is not exactly the best at grasping the whole idea, but most players are friendly and will help you out if you ask questions, and there is also a wikipedia for the game. For starters: don't give up on your first try, keep playing the game, it's really hard in the start because you got access to few weapons, and planets, so getting resources etc. is hard. But once you get going, you can be like everyone else, just dashing through the map, and slaughtering the grineer, corpus, infestation, or the corrupted.

This game uses a very interesting system. You have a Mastery Rank which is basically all the affinity (XP) you gathered so far. The higher your rank, the more weapons, warframes, and quests you got access to. This number can be increased by leveling up weapons, warframes, and other things like Companions. Companions? Yes. Like, your own dog, or cat, that you can customize, or little flying robot, a Sentinel. Also 1 thing worth remembering about mastery rank: you can't get more xp from 1 weapon if you have leveled a weapon to level 30 and selling it won't make you lose your already earned affinity.

There are many more things I could go on about, but I end it there. If you feel like you would give this a try, then do it. This game is really unique in multiple ways. If this game peeked your interest, then welcome Tenno. Hope you stay.

It's a pretty good game. Ive only played for a month and you still got a ton took forward too. The game fighting mechanics are above darksouls 3 (im a hardcore souls fan and im on my 15th rerun), and visually stunning game. You cant compare this games visuals because it has alot about everything. The story is good, no spoilers there, but if you like space fiction you are going to dig it. Join a good clan as they'll help you and if its a rank 10 you are free to use the tenno lab to construct weapons you otherwise wouldve paid alot of Plat. This is a 10/10 in game aspects. 8/10 for game updates. 6/10 for customer support as you can get banned for a week for using all CAP LETERS. Ridiculous so be careful. Story wise is a 7/10.
